title: Mechanical Watch Foundations
description: The whole movement first: power, train, winding, setting. Escapements and complications wait until the simple calibre is thinkable.

sourceReferences.title: HSNY Horology 101–103
sourceReferences.notes: 101 movement mechanics before 102 gear train before 103 winding/setting. Escapement is 104. Complications are not in the beginner ladder.

sourceReferences.title: WOSTEP training and education
sourceReferences.notes: Theory and component work before chronometry and chronograph as later specializations.
